name: Potato
summary: One-hour crop route and Fish and Chips ingredient.
detail: Potato is the safest early one-hour crop: easy to plan, useful for cooking, and strong enough for early Gold loops.

name: Wheat
detail: Wheat is better when the player will be away for several hours. It also gives the recipe finder a stable grain input.

name: Fish and Chips
detail: Fish and Chips is the bridge between fishing and farming. Use it when low-value fish need a better route than raw sale.

name: Huchen
summary: Giantwood River rare fish with level gate.
detail: Huchen belongs in a planned river route. Track it separately from lake and ocean targets so collection progress is visible.

name: Pet Shop
summary: Dog Food, cat-care items, adoption, and pet onboarding.
detail: The Pet Shop connects animal favorites, pet unlocks, and map routing. It should be treated as a core service, not a note inside NPC text.

name: Weather Bird Target
summary: Birdwatching route entity with weather and habitat gates.
detail: Weather Bird Target represents a birdwatching entry that should be tracked by weather, habitat, and album-confirmed photo state rather than a simple text note.

name: Rain Insect Target
summary: Insect route entity with rain, time, and habitat conditions.
detail: Rain Insect Target is a condition-based catch: check weather first, then time window, then habitat lane before spending a route.

name: Bubble Net
summary: Insect catching unlock tool and route material.
detail: Bubble Net is the tool gate for insect catching. Treat it as a route material connected to shops, guides, and the insect planner.

name: Doris
summary: Weather merchant and friendship route candidate.
detail: Doris is both a social target and a weather-sensitive merchant route. Link NPC details to shops, map markers, and friendship planning.

name: Oak-Oak
summary: Quest-specific companion separated from normal pets.
detail: Oak-Oak should not be mixed with pet-shop dogs or cats. Keep it in a quest-specific animal lane.

name: Profit Calculator
summary: Crop profit calculator with saved inputs and ranking table.
detail: Use the Profit Calculator before planting. It turns crop rows into an actionable Gold route.

name: Hobbies Hub
summary: Seven hobby route cards with checklist handoffs.
detail: Hobbies Hub closes the route gap across fishing, gardening, cooking, birdwatching, insects, cat care, and dog care.
